LESSON: METHODS OF COOKING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: HOME SCIENCE
Strand: Food and Nutrition
Topic 1.5: Methods of Cooking
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 20

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Methods of Cooking, part of Food and Nutrition in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 HOME SCIENCE.

Key inquiry question: Why is knowledge on methods of cooking important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss reasons for cooking food and present in class. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative communication modes as they share their views,

2. use digital and print resources to search on the classification of methods of cooking, general rules to be observed, advantages and disadvantages. (Moist heat- boiling, stewing, steaming, poaching, frying, dry heat- roasting, grilling, baking combination methods-braising) Learners with manipulation difficulty could use adapted digital devices with appropriate accessibility features. Screen resolution could be adjusted for learners who are sensitive to light and colour,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss reasons for cooking food and present in class. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative communication modes as they share their views,
2. use digital and print resources to search on the classification of methods of cooking, general rules to be observed, advantages and disadvantages. (Moist heat- boiling, stewing, steaming, poaching, frying, dry heat- roasting, grilling, baking combination methods-braising) Learners with manipulation difficulty could use adapted digital devices with appropriate accessibility features. Screen resolution could be adjusted for learners who are sensitive to light and colour,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Methods of Cooking together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: Learners show a concerted attention to detail as they apply the knowledge of cooking methods to prepare

food items.

● Digital literacy: Learners use digital devices to effectively accomplish their own tasks when they research the

classification of cooking methods.

● Citizenship: Learners promote social cohesion and harmony when cooking foods from different communities.

Values:
● Unity: Learners share available resources amicably during the preparation and cooking of food.

● Integrity: Learners display honesty when using resources while cooking food using the different cooking methods.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Health Promotion Issues: Learners are sensitised on health and nutrition issues as they discuss in groups reasons for cooking

food and present in class.

● Socio- economic and Environmental Issues: learners observe safety measures as they prepare and cook food.

Suggested learning resources:

Adapted cooking tools and equipment, selected food stuffs, laboratory/space, adapted digital resources,
